Repair is measured between the surveyed existing profile and the proposed section. Retained earth is excluded from the additional fill.
Average section value = (A1 + A2) / 2. Interval quantity = average section value × length.
Percentages are the selected dashboard classification applied to each measured source.
Each excavation DATA code is shown once, followed by the works contributing to its total.
Each work code is shown once, followed by the components that add to its total. Excavation quantities are in Total quantities of Excavation
above and are not repeated here. Distinct operations can share a measured volume; their quantities must not be added to obtain geometric fill.

Excavation area: A = W × D = 0.6 × 0.3 = 0.18 m². Lined perimeter: P = W + 2D = 1.2 m. Per chute,
excavation = A × developed length; protection = P × developed length × lining thickness.
U/S shelves sit on the left (water face, mirrored); D/S shelves sit on the right. Each figure is labelled with its shelf RL.
The shelf is included in the embankment geometry; only its selected
surfacing and drain works are additional quantities.
